MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 7 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 12
   D. 6

2. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

3. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 18

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 23
   D. 17

8. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 65
   C. 16
   D. 64

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

12. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 37

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

14. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 17
   D. 0

15. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

16. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 44
   C. 22
   D. 105

18. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 50

19. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

20. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

21. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

22. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 77
   C. 18
   D. 36

24. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

25. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

26. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

27. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

28. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 28
   C. 3
   D. 29

29. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

30. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
